title: Collab: replace user-facing 'peer' language with 'user'
description: USER REPORT (LOW, copy nit). User wants the collab UI to say 'user' instead of 'peer' in language the end-user actually sees ('peer' is jargon). Replace ONLY user-visible STRINGS; leave internal API/type/variable names (PeerPresence, usePeers, peerCountAdvice, the y-webrtc provider 'peers' event, simple-peer connections, localOrigin, etc.) and data-testids unchanged so nothing breaks. USER-VISIBLE 'peer' OCCURRENCES TO CHANGE (file:line - rendered text / titles): - packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/CollabControls.tsx:143-145 - the status-pill label: `${status.peers} ${status.peers === 1 ? "peer" : "peers"}` and the else branch "waiting for peers". -> e.g. "1 user" / "N users" / "waiting for others" (or "waiting for users"). - packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/peerCount.ts:54-57 - the high-count warning MESSAGE shown in the pill tooltip and the ShareDialog banner: `${participants} people are in this session. Collaboration uses a peer-to-peer mesh, so large groups...`. 'people'/'peer-to-peer mesh' is shown to users. Keep 'peer-to-peer' as the networking term if desired; the count noun is already 'people' (fine). Review for consistency with 'user'. - packages/authoring-ui/src/collab/ShareDialog.tsx - user-visible copy: - line 337: `Large session ({peerAdvice.participants} people).` - 'people' (already not 'peer', fine; listed for consistency review). - lines 104-109 (HonestNote): "Collaborators connect peer-to-peer over WebRTC, so ... flows directly between peers ...". 'peer-to-peer' is a precise networking term describing the WebRTC topology; recommend KEEPING 'peer-to-peer over WebRTC' (technical accuracy) but the trailing 'between peers' could become 'between participants'/'between users'. - line 351: "Signaling server unreachable. Peers already connected stay connected..." -> 'Users already connected...'. DISTINCTION (DO NOT CHANGE - internal, not user-visible): - All type/identifier names: PeerPresence, PeerEditContext, usePeers, getPeers, onPeersChange, symbolEditorsFromPeers, peerCountAdvice, PEER_COUNT_WARN_THRESHOLD, the status.peers field, the provider.on('peers') event (y-webrtc API), simple-peer PeerLike/conn.peer (webrtcAssetTransport.ts). - data-testids: collab-presence-peer, collab-peer-warn, collab-peer-warn-banner, data-peer-warn - these are test contracts; renaming them would break specs. Leave as-is (only the visible text changes). - Code comments mentioning 'peer' are not user-visible; optional to touch. RECOMMENDATION: keep the precise networking term 'peer-to-peer (over WebRTC)' where it describes the connection topology (HonestNote), but replace the count/participant noun 'peer'/'peers' with 'user'/'users' (CollabControls label, 'Peers already connected' in ShareDialog, 'between peers' -> 'between users'). FIX DIRECTION ONLY - not applied. Related: task 1354/1356/1357 (collab).
